# SNAPBACK

> SNAPBACK checks a rental listing against the home's own record (the property record, the
> building's 3D scan and aerial imagery) before a renter pays, then finds researched places that
> fit the renter's budget. Code, not a language model, sets every verdict. SNAPBACK never pays,
> books or sends anything; the renter approves and sends any message themselves.

Every result is labelled LIVE (real records) or FIXTURE (synthetic demo data made by the team).
The strongest verdict is "Don't pay. Something here doesn't match." SNAPBACK never calls a
person a scammer, and no reply from a poster means hold, not failure.

## For agents: the MCP server

SNAPBACK ships an MCP server (stdio, or streamable HTTP on localhost behind a bearer token). From
a checkout of the repo, with the API running (`make api`):

    claude mcp add snapback -- uv run python -m snapback.mcp_server

Tools:

- snapback_check_listing(ad_text, photo_urls=[], max_rent=null): start a check. Returns the case
  id, LIVE or FIXTURE, the status and a link to the result page. Photo links must come from the
  renter.
- snapback_get_verdict(case_id): the result card: verdict words, each check line with its
  status, what is not checked, and the one next step. Repeat the verdict as given.
- snapback_find_places(brief): ask the Finder in plain words ("1 bed under 1500, no walk-ups").
  Returns picks and any proposal the renter must answer.
- snapback_accept_preference(proposal_id, yes): the renter's own yes or no on a proposal. Only
  call it after the renter has answered.
- snapback_walk_summary(case_id): the rooms of the home's 3D walk, which ad photo landed where,
  and a link to Walk it first.
- snapback_draft_tour_request(case_id, place_id): a draft to the leasing office on record.
  Nothing is sent.

Tokens never leave the MCP server. Errors are plain sentences.

## Docs

- [MCP setup, tools and an example conversation](https://github.com/DevSingh05/snapback/blob/main/docs/mcp.md)
- [README](https://github.com/DevSingh05/snapback#readme)

## Rules for renters

- Never pay before a signed lease and a viewing.
- Never pay by Zelle, wire or gift card.
- Only trust a SNAPBACK result you asked for yourself. SNAPBACK never texts first or asks for
  money.
